fact: The first-round 2024/25 Crops, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment (CLAFA-1), led by ZIMSTAT with the Ministry of Lands, Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Rural Development, used satellite data with remote sensing tools as one of three methods and reports NDVI crop condition maps; ZINGSA and SIRDC were engaged on crop models and FAO EOSTAT ran a pilot.
title: CLAFA-1: First Round Crops, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment, 2024/2025 summer season
publisher: Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency (ZIMSTAT) and Ministry of Lands, Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Rural Development
